rule: All addresses and message IDs use example.test; subdomains also end .test; no real users credentials phone numbers or payment details
verification: Scan decoded headers bodies and assets against controlled source values

rule: All templates profiles and assets shipped locally; no SMTP IMAP HTTP DNS or filesystem reads outside configured plan and packaged assets
HTML limited to passive tags and inline styling; no scripts events forms frames remote styles external images or data URIs; href values only https://example.test/...
verification: Allowlist HTML validation and decoded URL checks

rule: Reviewed PNG JPEG PDF TXT CSV only; no executables macros archives decompression bombs EICAR or exploit payloads
verification: Asset inventory SHA-256 sizes media types dimensions and review metadata

rule: Core output RFC 5322/MIME-compatible; malformed and structurally adversarial cases only selected explicitly and stored in stress/
verification: Normal corpus has no planned parse defects; stress IDs and defects manifest-marked

rule: Max 10000 messages; max 5242880 serialized bytes per message; max 268435456 serialized bytes per batch
verification: Plan conservative estimate and streaming byte accounting; never publish partial destination

rule: Normal max depth 16; stress max depth 64; max 1000 total MIME nodes per message including embedded message roots
verification: Iterative tree traversal and bounded serialization

rule: Max total raw headers across entire message 65536 bytes; max raw single header field 16384 bytes; valid lines at most 998 octets
verification: Byte-level accounting before publish; oversized stress line remains inside byte caps

rule: Max 20 attachment leaves per message; max decoded attachment 2097152 bytes; images at most 2048 by 2048 pixels
verification: Count and decoded size accounting; no expanding container formats

rule: Root depth 1; every contained MIME entity increases depth including message/rfc822 embedded root; depth fixture uses linear chain
verification: Manifest tree depth and node paths checked by independent bounded traversal

rule: Fix seed dates timezone offsets IDs boundaries header order folding transfer encodings asset bytes and serialization policy
verification: Golden hashes on pinned Python patch dependencies generator revision catalog and templates

rule: Use curated localized prose; explicit effective Faker locale per field; no environment locale or silent body fallback
verification: Reject missing reviewed templates; manifest records fallback fields

rule: Profiles describe synthetic header shapes with pinned revision; no real DKIM ARC signatures or claims of deliverability
verification: Authentication placeholders marked synthetic; sanitized evidence required before exact-version fidelity

rule: Planner establishes semantic and raw assertions before serialization; parser output never supplies sole expected result
verification: Compare bytes and bounded parser output to plan assertions; preserve duplicate headers as arrays

rule: Generated index-and-ID ASCII filenames; prohibit existing destination symlinks traversal and arbitrary attachment extraction
verification: Negative path checks; only own staging files cleaned on failure

rule: Safe refers to inert content; intentionally stressful structure can exhaust or crash weak parsers; never open with a desktop client automatically
verification: Manifest recommends isolated parser subprocess with timeout memory cap and no network

rule: Stress acceptance is bounded success rejection or documented defect; never promise every parser crashes or emits identical defect names
verification: Separate generator assertions from suggested parser resource/defect expectations

rule: Create local fixtures and packaging; no mail sending account login inbox scraping live provider API or existing-mail anonymization
verification: CLI catalog has no network delivery commands
